import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

def case(transitions, target, want):
    states = ["Q0", "X", "Y", "Z", "T", "W"]
    types = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": states},
             {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 0},
             {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]],
                "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
    machine = {"states": states, "initial": "Q0", "state_param": "st",
               "message_param": "msg", "transitions": transitions}
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    index = states.index(target)
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [index, 0])])}]
    out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
    got = out["corpus"][0]["commands"][:-1] if out["corpus"] else None
    cost = out["corpus"][0]["cost"] if out["corpus"] else None
    print(target, got, cost, out["records"][0]["status"], "want", want)
    assert got == want[0] and cost == want[1], (got, cost, want)


def t(frm, to, cmd, cost):
    return {"from": frm, "to": to, "command": cmd, "cost": cost, "when": None}

# the whole 'a' prefix dead-ends, so 'b' must win even though 'a' < 'b'
case([t("Q0", "X", "a", 1), t("X", "Z", "c", 1), t("Q0", "Y", "b", 1),
     t("Y", "T", "d", 1)], "T", (["b", "d"], 2))
# a dead-end deeper in the sequence
case([t("Q0", "X", "a", 1), t("X", "Z", "c", 1), t("X", "T", "m", 1)],
     "T", (["a", "m"], 2))
# equal cost, equal hops, sequence tie broken late
case([t("Q0", "X", "a", 1), t("Q0", "Y", "a", 1), t("X", "T", "y", 1),
     t("Y", "T", "x", 1), t("X", "W", "b", 1), t("W", "T", "c", 1)],
     "T", (["a", "x"], 2))
# cheapest route is longer in hops: cost dominates hop count
case([t("Q0", "X", "z", 1), t("X", "T", "z", 1), t("Q0", "T", "a", 5)],
     "T", (["z", "z"], 2))
print("LEX OK")
PYEOF
